mapper.select: SELECT s.project_id FROM step s WHERE s.step_id = #{stepId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT s.step_id AS stepId, s.name AS stepName FROM step s WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC

SELECT i.issue_id AS issueId, i.version AS version, i.step_id AS stepId, i.title AS title, i.content AS content, CASE i.status WHEN 'TO_DO' THEN 'TODO' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.priority AS priority, i.due_date AS dueDate, i.finish_day AS completedAt FROM issue i JOIN step s ON s.step_id = i.step_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, i.issue_id DESC
SELECT b.block_id AS blockId, b.step_id AS stepId FROM block b WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.issue_id AS issueId, i.version AS version, i.step_id AS stepId, i.title AS title, i.content AS content, CASE i.status WHEN 'TO_DO' THEN 'TODO' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.priority AS priority, i.due_date AS dueDate, i.finish_day AS completedAt FROM issue i WHERE i.step_id = #{stepId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM issue_block ib WHERE ib.issue_id = i.issue_id AND ib.block_id = #{blockId} )
ORDER BY i.issue_id DESC

SELECT i.issue_id AS issueId, i.version AS version, i.step_id AS stepId, i.title AS title, i.content AS content, CASE i.status WHEN 'TO_DO' THEN 'TODO' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.priority AS priority, i.due_date AS dueDate, i.finish_day AS completedAt FROM issue i WHERE i.issue_id = #{issueId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, e.resigned_at AS resignedAt FROM employee e WHERE e.user_id IN
#{userId}

SELECT i.issue_id AS issueId, i.version AS version, i.title AS title, CASE i.status WHEN 'TO_DO' THEN 'TODO' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.priority AS priority, i.due_date AS dueDate, s.step_id AS stepId, s.name AS stepName, p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM issue i JOIN issue_assign ia ON ia.issue_id = i.issue_id AND ia.user_id = #{userId} JOIN step s ON s.step_id = i.step_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status != 'DONE' AND i.due_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.due_date ASC, i.issue_id DESC
